parse_notes: Closed local observations on frozen synthetic benches. No generated answer, prompt, answer key, weight or machine log is published; no role is adopted.

Nanbeige4.3-33B (Nanbeige), GGUF Q4_K_M (bartowski, third-party conversion), on ONE RTX 3090 FE: all 52 layers (and the output layer) on GPU, 16,384-token context, one llama.cpp slot, so the eight requests of the house protocol are served one after another.

Same weights and image as nanbeige4.3-33b-pair, the conditional arm on the other topology. Single stream 37.9 tok/s against 38.7 for nanbeige4.3-33b-pair, aggregate 38.0 against 38.7 (three passes each, one slot): about 2 % slower single stream than the main record, in all three passes.
The predeclared fit search loaded at its first setting (6.3 s).

Picked from a public model watch, downloaded at a fixed revision and checked by SHA-256, with its arms written and its fit searched before they ran; the conditional arm on the other topology ran after this model's planned arms had finished.

Run from 23:51 UTC on 26 October to 01:53 UTC on 27 October (the night of 27 October in Swiss time), in a window opened that night with the owner's go-ahead after the model watch; no process ran on the other pair of the host at the start of each arm.
